The '''Floubette dance''' was an aesthetically pleasing dance that idealized the [[Floubettean/Legends|Floubettean]] mating ritual. Traditionally performed by [[Bird/Legends|avian]] species, only one [[Human/Legends|Human]] performer was known to exist; [[Jantaa Binx]]. The Human interpretation of the dance was considered to be be shocking and vulgar.
